title: Ready Clean ABC
hook: Clean enough for the task is the goal.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D daily-routine storybook, simple home actions and objects, clean morning-evening scenes; visual identity: Ready Clean ABC

creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Ready Clean ABC about hygiene and preparation boundaries: washing hands, clean towels, food containers, clothing, dinner, vitamins and bedding are different care tasks; cleanliness never becomes fear of ordinary dirt or germs.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child learns useful hygiene moments and adult-managed medicine/food tasks without compulsive cleaning language.
